sections.title: Getting started
sections.description: Most Beta 1.7.3 mods run on a Fabric-style loader. Set one up first, then drop mod jars into the `mods` folder of your instance.
sections.note: Server plugins, such as Poseidon plugins, are in the Plugins section of the hub. This page is for mods that run in the game client, plus a few that also need installing on a server.

links.title: Babric
links.description: Fabric for Beta Minecraft: installer, barn mappings and a b1.7.3 intermediary. The loader most mods on this page expect.
links.tags: babric fabric loader installer mappings barn

links.tags: babric prism launcher instance install setup

links.description: RetroMC's Beta 1.7.3 client, with its own ModLoader-style mod loader. Mods not made for the Beta Evolutions 2 mod loader may not work, so check what a mod was built for.

links.title: Ornithe
links.description: Another loader and toolchain for old versions, Beta 1.7.3 included. Some mods here list Ornithe as well as Babric.
